experiment: phase-only verification of local crossing-time action
freezeOrder: Freeze controller before scoring these four phases. Retain failures, no-offer results and complete matched pairs.
interpretation: The same course and run-up are used across these four new phases. The filmed example may be selected from development. Controls are real closed-loop runs.
acceptance: Compare time only when both arms finish with >=0.15 m cone clearance and >=0.08 m road clearance. Measure actual speed change after positive action and before passing, full rear-clearance time, and the later lateral occupancy of the chosen strip. If the cone never reaches that strip, classify as spatial avoidance.
